propertyDetails.description: WOW! This home is one of a kind! Elegant 3,135-square-foot 5 Bed/3.5 Bath executive estate sits on a 9,375-square foot lot. Separate In-Law unit with full kitchen, bed & bath (+454 SF)--perfect for parents or a rental! This property shouts quality with marble, cherry & maple hardwood floors; granite counters & cherry cabinets; high-end appliances & luxury features throughout. A Must See! 3-car garage plus a huge rear yard with covered patio. Quiet neighborhood in award-winning school district: Sedgwick Elementary, Hyde Middle School, Cupertino High School.
